```{r}

mapCellTypes <- function(df){
  #append mapping, if there is no match, value will be "no match"
  names(df)[names(df) == "cell_type"] <- "author_cell_type"
  df <- merge(df, cellTypeMapping, by = "author_cell_type")
  df <- df %>% mutate(abbr = ifelse(is.na(abbr), "no match", abbr))
}

abbreviateCellType <- function(df){
df <- merge(df, cellAbbreviations, by.x = "cell_type", by.y = "true_cell_type", all.x = TRUE)
df <- df %>% mutate(abbr = ifelse(is.na(abbr), "no match", abbr))
}
abbreviateGemma <- function(df){
df <- merge(df, GemmaLabels, by.x = "cell_type", by.y = "GemmaCellTypes", all.x = TRUE)
}

cellCountPlot <- function(df, plotTitle, type_col, angle, ylim){
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = type_col, fill = type_col)) +
  geom_bar() +
  geom_text(stat = "count",
            aes(label= ..count..), 
            vjust=-0.3, 
            color = "black", 
            size = 2.5,) +
  labs(
    title = plotTitle,
    x = "cell types",
    y = "Count") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, ylim),
      labels = label_comma(),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)))+
     theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "none", 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, angle = angle, hjust = 1))
  
}

```

# Counts of Gemma cell type annotations vs. author cell type annotations

## CMC

```{r}
CMCGemmaAbbr <- abbreviateGemma(CMCGemma)
CMCGemmaClean <- subset(CMCGemma, select = -c(sample_id, cell_type_uri))
CMCGemmaClean <- abbreviateCellType(CMCGemmaClean)

CMCAuthorClean <- subset(CMCAuthor, select =-c(sample_id, cell_type_uri)) 
CMCAuthorClean <- mapCellTypes(CMCAuthorClean)


cellCountPlot(CMCGemmaAbbr, "CMC Gemma Annotations", CMCGemmaAbbr$Abbreviations, 20, 200500) #raw gemma annotations, some not in mapping file

cellCountPlot(CMCAuthor, "CMC Author Annotations", CMCAuthor$cell_type, 45, 200500) #author annotations


cellCountPlot(CMCGemmaClean, "Mapped CMC Gemma Annotations", CMCGemmaClean$abbr, 17, 200500) #gemma annotations as mapped to main list, some no match

cellCountPlot(CMCAuthorClean, "Gemma-mapped CMC Author Annotations", CMCAuthorClean$abbr, 17, 200500) #author annotations mapped to list

```
